## Summary

What capability do you want?

## Use case

Who needs it and why?

## Current behavior

Which existing API or language profile did you try, and what is missing?

## Core scope

Explain the generic language/runtime mechanism needed. Application-specific
schemas, business rules and example applications belong in separate projects.

## Constraints

Security, capability, ABI or compatibility constraints.
